name: Busujima Takeru
source: Third year student at Kamijou Gakuen and the student council accountant. The protagonist's good friend, he often helps him reject girls. Very strong body, coupled with a ferocious appearance, everyone tends to avoid him, especially girls who is very afraid of him. But his personality is the exact opposite of his appearance, he is actually very kind and gentle.
